name: ES Mean Reversion — Bollinger Bands + RSI
description: Mean reversion strategy on E-mini S&P 500 (ES) futures. Enters long when price closes below the lower Bollinger Band with RSI oversold (<30), enters short when price closes above the upper Bollinger Band with RSI overbought (>70). Exits when price reverts to the middle band (20-day SMA). ATR-based stop loss (2× ATR) protects against runaway trending moves. Uses BackwardPanamaCanal adjustment with LiquidityBased rollover for realistic continuation.
source:
# ES Mean Reversion — Bollinger Bands + RSI
# =============================================================================
# CONCEPT:
# Mean reversion assumes price will return to its average after extreme
# deviations. Bollinger Bands define the "extreme" via statistical volatility
# bands; RSI confirms momentum exhaustion at those extremes.
#
# ENTRY RULES:
# - Long:  Close < Lower Band (prior bar) AND RSI < 30 (oversold)
# - Short: Close > Upper Band (prior bar) AND RSI > 70 (overbought)
#
# EXIT RULES (first to trigger wins):
# - Mean reversion exit: Close crosses back through the middle band (20-SMA)
# - ATR stop loss: 2× ATR(14) from entry price to cap drawdown
#
# PARAMETERS:
# - Bollinger Bands: 20-period SMA, ±2 standard deviations
# - RSI: 14-period, oversold=30, overbought=70
# - ATR Stop: 14-period ATR × 2.0 multiplier
# - Position size: 100% (single contract equivalent)
# - Rollover: LiquidityBased | Adjustment: BackwardPanamaCanal
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# 1. DATA SOURCE — Futures Continuation
# =============================================================================
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()

# Build a gap-free continuous price series
# BackwardPanamaCanal: additive adjustment removes roll gaps — best for
# trend/mean-reversion analysis where price level continuity matters
cont = futures_continuation(
    timeframe=1D,
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

open_  = cont.o
high   = cont.h
low    = cont.l
close  = cont.c

# =============================================================================
# 2. INDICATORS
# =============================================================================

# --- Bollinger Bands (20-period, 2 stddev) ---
bb = bbands(period=20, stddev=2)(close)
bb_upper  = bb.bbands_upper
bb_middle = bb.bbands_middle
bb_lower  = bb.bbands_lower

# Lag bands by 1 bar to avoid look-ahead bias:
# today's bands are computed using today's close, so we can only act on them
# at tomorrow's open. Comparing today's close to the PRIOR bar's band levels
# is the correct, non-biased approach.
bb_upper_prior  = bb_upper  >> 1
bb_lower_prior  = bb_lower  >> 1
bb_middle_prior = bb_middle >> 1

# --- RSI (14-period) ---
rsi_val = rsi(period=14)(close)

# --- ATR (14-period) for stop loss distance ---
atr_val = atr(period=14)(high, low, close)

# Stop distance = 2 × ATR — gives price room to breathe while capping risk
stop_dist = 2 * atr_val

# =============================================================================
# 3. ENTRY SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# LONG: Price has closed below the lower band (statistically stretched to
# downside) AND RSI confirms momentum is oversold (exhaustion of sellers)
long_entry_signal = (close < bb_lower_prior) and (rsi_val < 30)

# SHORT: Price has closed above the upper band (statistically stretched to
# upside) AND RSI confirms momentum is overbought (exhaustion of buyers)
short_entry_signal = (close > bb_upper_prior) and (rsi_val > 70)

# =============================================================================
# 4. EXIT SIGNALS — Mean Reversion Target
# =============================================================================

# Exit long when price crosses back up through the middle band (mean achieved)
# Exit short when price crosses back down through the middle band (mean achieved)
# crossover/crossunder detect the exact bar the crossing occurs
long_exit_signal  = crossover(close, bb_middle_prior)
short_exit_signal = crossunder(close, bb_middle_prior)

# Convert pulse entry signals to held (continuous) signals
# hold_until keeps the position open until the exit fires
held_long  = hold_until()(enter=long_entry_signal,  exit=long_exit_signal)
held_short = hold_until()(enter=short_entry_signal, exit=short_exit_signal)

# =============================================================================
# 5. EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

# Wire the front contract for rollover detection (required for futures)
rollover_policy()(active=cont.s)

# Zone executor: handles long/short position state, prevents duplicate entries
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# ATR-based stop loss — atomic: bundles position sizing + stop distance
# risk_pct=2: risk 2% of equity per trade
# stop_distance: 2× ATR from entry price
# stop_unit='price': distance is in price points (absolute)
risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.price)(risk_pct=2, stop_distance=stop_dist)

# =============================================================================
# 6. EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

# Long entry markers (oversold + below lower band)
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Long Entry — Oversold Extreme",
    icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close",        type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Lower Band",   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="RSI",          type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(title="ATR",          type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Stop Dist",    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, bb_lower_prior, rsi_val, atr_val, stop_dist, long_entry_signal)

# Short entry markers (overbought + above upper band)
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Short Entry — Overbought Extreme",
    icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close",        type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Upper Band",   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="RSI",          type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(title="ATR",          type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Stop Dist",    type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, bb_upper_prior, rsi_val, atr_val, stop_dist, short_entry_signal)

# Mean-reversion exit markers (long exit — middle band reached)
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Long Exit — Mean Reverted",
    icon=Icon.TargetIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close",       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Middle Band", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="RSI",         type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, bb_middle_prior, rsi_val, long_exit_signal)

# Mean-reversion exit markers (short exit — middle band reached)
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Short Exit — Mean Reverted",
    icon=Icon.TargetIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close",       type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Middle Band", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="RSI",         type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, bb_middle_prior, rsi_val, short_exit_signal)
